description: One published article as Markdown: its canonical address, feed id, publish and modified dates, any correction, key points, sections, updates and linked sources. Takes a feed entry's _emergent_fm.article_id (a story id like "story-6", a change id like "change-12" or a guide id like "guide-openai-batch"), or the entry's id or url (its page address); a change linked to a story answers with the story, and a guide answers with its public part only (title, summary, format, sources, dossier). A deleted story or withdrawn change is not found.

id.description: The article to read: a feed entry's _emergent_fm.article_id, like "story-6"; a tracked change's, like "change-12"; a guide's, like "guide-openai-batch"; or the entry's id or url itself, like "https://emergent.fm/stories/6". A change linked to a story answers with the story. A guide answers with its public part: title, summary, format, sources and dossier; its full body is on a reader's own connection.
